capabilities: Design TikZ and pgfplots charts visually
Drag points, lines and labels to update their formulas
Plot 2D functions, 3D surfaces, vector fields and fractals
Insert generated pgfplots code into notes
disambiguation: Not Obsidian's note graph view; it draws math charts as TikZ and pgfplots figures.
extras: Free and open source (MIT). Nothing is sent to the internet and there is no telemetry; the 6.0 film loads from youtube-nocookie.com only when Play is pressed, and AI access is off by default and answers on 127.0.0.1 with your token. The Help tab holds 79 step-by-step guides.
problem: Hand-writing TikZ and pgfplots code to get math figures into notes is slow and means juggling code and camera angles.

relations.evidence: GeoGebra lines paste as they are.
A Python block with NumPy and matplotlib draws in the chart and can play over time

summary: Visual editor for TikZ and pgfplots math charts with a live SVG preview, draggable objects, sliders and one-click code insertion.
